rows.en: ...It seems we do take some damage after all.
Normally, not even we Ultra Warriors could last a minute inside the tower.
...It seems we do take some damage after all.
Normally, not even we Ultra Warriors could last a minute inside the tower.
...We do take some damage after all, don't we.
Normally, not even Ultra Warriors can last a minute inside the tower.
...It seems we do take some damage after all.
Normally, not even Ultra Warriors can last a minute inside the tower.
...Guess we've got no choice but to go on.
Keeping us, the Alien Alliance, waiting? You've got some nerve!
But that damage zone must have weakened you lot quite a bit!
You think something like that would weaken us?
You think something like that would weaken us?
Do you really think something like that would weaken us!?
You think something like that would weaken us?
You think something like that would weaken us?
Did you think something like that would weaken us?
You seriously think a little thing like that's gonna weaken us!
As if something like that could weaken us!?
Did you really think something like that would weaken us!?
You think something like that would weaken us?
You thought something like that would weaken us!!
You think something like that would weaken us?
You think something like that would weaken us?
Come, let us begin at once!
I can't wait! After all, whoever wins this match goes on to the finals!
But let me make one thing clear: we are the ones who will rule this Cube!
In strength and fame alike, there is no one but us, the Alien Alliance!!
Pests like you will be wiped out in this match, without fail!
Well then, shall we start the match?
Hey, hey, you're getting cold feet after coming all this way? Pathetic bastard!
...Just like Jack and the others said, they've brought out Black King.
...To think that I... that the Alien Alliance would be beaten...!!
But... even if you beat us, you'll never make it to the finals...!
The change of venue... and the damage zone... We've bought ourselves plenty of time...
Y-You lot will... run out of time... and be... disqualified!
So it was a trap after all!!

notes.note: #0.51-0.63 are 13 leader variants; 0436.bla chain Pt_Chara_Check 5,4,3,15,14,6,7,2,1,11,12,9,10 = OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), Zero, Mebius, Nu, Zeta, RX, Rider 1, Ultraman, Seven, Wing Zero, 00. So #0.53 is Momotaros ('Oi!!'), #0.55 Mebius (polite -san on Ankh dropped per honorific rule).

0437 plays only with an Ultra leader: chain 11,12,14,15 = Ultraman (#0.2/0.3), Seven (#0.4/0.5), Mebius (#0.6/0.7, polite), Zero (#0.8/0.9). Ultraman/Seven say 'we Ultra Warriors'. 'The tower' = the venue tower with the damage zone (cf. Nackle #0438 0.60).
Ankh's line for the no-Ultra branch (script +9); 'go on' = press on through the damage zone. Subject 'we' restored.

#0.7-0.19 leader variants; order from 0438.bla chain 11,12,14,15,5,4,3,2,1,6,7,9,10 = Ultraman, Seven, Mebius (#0.9, boku), Zero, OOO, W (#0.12 Philip-like boku/kai), Momotaros (#0.13, yagaru), RX (#0.14), Rider 1 (#0.15), Nu, Zeta (#0.17), Wing Zero, 00. Wording fits this order; identical JP kept identical.

Not played by any MessWinSet in 0438.bla (script jumps +25 -> +33); probably the prompt before a start-the-match Yes/No choice, with #0.34 the taunt on declining. Speaker unlabelled; casual 'ze' suggests Alien Nackle.
'Ready... GO!!' matches the fight call in story_071 (0414 #0.75).
Black King (Ultraman Jack kaiju) is not in the glossary; used the established franchise English name.
#0.46-0.58 leader variants (same order as #0.7-0.19): #0.49 Zero and #0.52 Momotaros use the rough 'ikiteiyagatta', rendered with 'damn it'. Leader reacting to the beaten Nackle (#0.45).
#0.64-0.76 thirteen identical leader variants (first labelled 00) cut off mid-sentence; the next rows show the remaining time of the 'Survival Eleven' limit, so rendered 'The time limit...!!'.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant orders taken from the 0436/0437/0438.bla Pt_Chara_Check chains. 0438 #0.27 is not played by the script (likely a Yes/No prompt, speaker inferred as Nackle). 'Black King' not in glossary (franchise English).
